title: Removing an explicit key leaves the explicit empty key after it intact
notes: In `{? a, ? : 1}` the first entry is `? a` with an empty value and the second is `? ` (an empty key) with the value 1 (productions 143 and 144: a flow pair is an explicit entry with an optional key and an optional value). Removing the member `a` removes the first entry and its separator; the second entry stays exactly as written, so the empty key still holds 1 and the text is `{? : 1}`.

provenance.reference: An editor that dropped the question mark of the second entry together with the first, so that the entry changed meaning.
